verdict.line: You lose if you E into her raised W every time; you win by forcing Q trades and landing E only when her Riposte is down.

brief.thesis: This matchup is decided entirely by E (Test of Spirit): if Fiora's W (Riposte) is up, she parries it and the trade flips hard. Illaoi still holds the measured edge here — 46.9% over 712 games is close to even and both lane advantage and solo-kill advantage favor Illaoi — but that edge only shows up if you bait Riposte before committing E.

theirWindow.what: She can parry your E on reaction, negating the spirit-link damage and the Tentacle swings it triggers. Do not throw E here — walk up with Q (Tentacle Smash) or autos instead and wait her out.

yourWindow.when: Riposte just went down or she used it on a minion
yourWindow.what: E immediately. The spirit echoes damage back to her with no parry risk, and Tentacles join in — this is your biggest single trade of the level.

start.why: 43.9% win rate over 494 games (55.6% pick) — the sustain and damage help you survive early Lunge pokes while you wait for Riposte windows

boots.why: 45.3% over 623 games (76.7% pick) — Fiora's autos and Lunge procs are physical, so the flat reduction blunts her all-in burst more than Mercury's would

core.why: Shreds her armor so your E/Tentacle swings and autos hit harder through extended trades
The slow on proc keeps her inside Tentacle range when she tries to disengage after a bad Riposte read
The shield covers you through her Blade Waltz burst once she hits level 6

situational.when: she builds full lifesteal/crit and her passive sustain is winning extended trades
she's snowballing early and you need armor plus grievous wounds sooner than a full core item
you need to survive her burst windows to let Tentacles finish the trade

runes.keystoneWhy: Rewards the slow, repeated trades this matchup is built around — you proc it every time you land E or walk up for Q, and the health scaling helps you win the war of attrition her passive sustain is trying to start

summoners.why: 48.3% win rate and the highest pick rate (45.7%) — Teleport lets you reset after losing an early E trade to a Riposte parry without bleeding CS, since this matchup is won over many trades, not one all-in

playing.title: Track Riposte, not her health
playing.detail: Her W (Riposte, 10-6s cooldown) is the only thing that matters before you commit E. If it's up, don't throw E — it gets parried and you lose the whole trade.

playing.title: Use Q to poke, not to commit
playing.detail: Q (Tentacle Smash, 10-6s cooldown, 850 range) is safe chip damage while you wait for her Riposte to go down. It doesn't require you to stand in Lunge range.

playing.title: Never let her close the gap for free
playing.detail: Her E (Burst of Speed) ramps her attack speed and move speed on landed hits or Lunges. Once she's stacking it, disengage rather than trying to out-trade her in melee.

playing.title: Save E for the exact window
playing.detail: The instant Riposte goes on cooldown — whether baited, wasted on a minion, or used on your Tentacle — land E. This is your biggest damage spike of the level and triggers nearby Tentacles to swing too.

playing.title: Respect level 6 Blade Waltz
playing.detail: Her R (130-110s cooldown) dashes to every nearby champion for physical damage that gets weaker on repeat hits to you specifically. Don't overextend past minion waves once she hits 6.

playing.title: Use R to punish a landed E
playing.detail: Per the matchup read, your R (Leap of Faith) is strongest right after a successful E — follow up for a huge damage window and extra Tentacle spawns, since E is the ability she's built to deny most of the time.

playing.title: Never initiate at low HP
playing.detail: Her passive (Duelist) heals her on every hit landed, so she wins extended fights once ahead. Walk away and reset with Teleport rather than trying to force a kill when behind.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and all win rates/sample sizes above are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch (16.19.1); the tactical reading — Riposte windows, trade timing, power spikes — is my own analysis layered on that data.

stats.opponentTip: Fiora has the upper hand as her (W) can block Illaoi’s main dealing ability [E]. Use your [Q] to harass or farm lane, but always keep your distance and do not allow Fiora to close in. Try not to engage Fiora if possible. However, harass her if with [R] if [E] lands successfully after reaching level 6. Illaoi will not have many opportunities to harass Fiora as [E] will be blocked, so try to make the most out of it when it lands.
